primary_endpoint.hypothesis_test: two-sided task-level paired sign permutation test
primary_endpoint.metric: verifier pass fraction over two attempts per task
primary_endpoint.name: paired Sealed21 pass-rate difference
primary_endpoint.success_rule: delta > 0, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and p < 0.05

bootstrap.percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted samples, q*(n-1) (Hyndman-Fan type 7)

permutation.aggregation: mean signed pass difference across attempts within task
permutation.algorithm: dynamic programming over rational task effects

missingness_policy.classification: infrastructure-invalid is neither pass nor behavioral fail
missingness_policy.completion_rule: both harnesses must have zero unresolved invalid cells
missingness_policy.failure_rule: if invalid cells remain after allowed reruns, report Sealed21 as incomplete

multiplicity.rationale: one pre-registered model, split, contrast, and primary endpoint
